english.title: Quit Britain with a view to accept military / naval service with state at war with friendly state
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a British subject, without the license of His Majesty,

(A)_[quit]_
(B)_[went on board a ship with a view of quitting]_

His Majesty’s dominions, with intent to accept a commission or engagement in the military or naval service of a foreign state, namely **(..SPECIFY STATE..), at war with a friendly state, namely **(..SPECIFY FRIENDLY STATE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5 of the Foreign Enlistment Act 1870.

english.notes:
(i) The term of imprisonment to be awarded in respect of any offence against this Act shall not exceed two years.
(ii) Section 10 of the Interpretation Act 1978 states that any reference to the Sovereign reigning at the time of the passing of the Act is to be construed, unless the contrary intention appears, as a reference to the Sovereign for the time being. As such, references to ‘Her Majesty’ and ‘the Queen’ have been replaced in the wording of the offences to state ‘His Majesty’ or ‘the King’, although this may not be the strict wording of the legislation.
